artworks.title: Julia Dodd (Mrs. George Dodd)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Albert M. Friend, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up, seated in a three-quarter view facing slightly to her right. Her facial features include high cheekbones, a straight nose, and brown eyes. Her hair is parted in the middle and smoothed back tightly, revealing her ears. She is wearing a dark dress with a high collar and white lace trim. Around her neck is a large bow or tie with light and dark blue stripes, accented by a brooch at the center. She has gold hoop earrings. The chair she sits in has a rich red upholstery with ornate wooden carvings. The background is a muted dark color.

artworks.title: The Sisters
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Curt H. Reisinger
artworks.description: Two pale-skinned girls stand hand in hand in a grassy field in this vertical painting. To our left, the younger girl is about two heads shorter than her companion and holds a doll clutched in the crook of her right arm. She has short, light blond hair, and she stares at us or just above our heads with wide, blue eyes. She has round cheeks, and her rosebud-shaped mouth is parted. She wears a moss-green skirt patterned with lilac-purple flowers, a tan sash around her waist, and a shirt with violet-purple and navy-blue, vertical stripes on the torso and elbow-length white sleeves. One calf-high boot slouches down and the other brushes the bottom of her flaring skirts. Her doll wears a grayish-blue dress with a brown hem and fog-gray stockings. The taller girl on our right holds the smaller girl’s hand and turns to look down at her. Her cheeks are rosy, and her flaxen yellow hair falls nearly to her shoulders. She wears a vivid, apricot-orange dress with elbow-length sleeves, a light blue kerchief tied in a bow around her neck, and dark brown stockings and shoes. The girls stand close to each other and us in front of a grassy field dotted with blue, yellow, and white flowers. Two white goats graze in the distance behind the smaller girl. Reddish brown roofs suggest that houses nestle into a dip beyond the meadow. Smoke curls from a couple chimneys. The horizon nearly reaches the top edge of the painting so only a sliver of silvery gray sky lines the top of the composition. The artist signed the bottom right corner: “Gari Melchers.”

artworks.title: Hugo Reisinger
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Curt H. Reisinger
artworks.description: This painting shows a portrait of a middle-aged man who looks out at us. He is seated in a chair, turned slightly to the left, with his hands holding a gray hat in his lap. The man has pale skin with a brown mustache and a neatly trimmed beard, and his hair is slicked back and appears to be balding. He is wearing a dark suit with a white shirt and a patterned tie. On one of his fingers, he wears a gold ring. The background of the painting is an ornate interior, with richly patterned wallpaper, drapery, or furniture suggested by thick brushstrokes in shades of brown, tan, and black.

artworks.title: My Gems
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Avalon Foundation
artworks.description: A smoking pipe, piccolo, books, sheet music, an oil-burning lamp, a white and blue pitcher, and a few matches are arranged on a wooden tabletop against a dark background in this vertical still life painting. The black piccolo has a white mouthpiece and is propped on some books at the center of the composition. The piccolo rests on the spine of a paper-bound book, which in turn leans on a volume bound in brown leather tooled with green, red, and gold bands. Under the book, a baby-blue page sits on some sheet music that drapes over the front of the table toward us. The blue cover bears the letters, “RICOLETT” and the sheet music below is labeled, “HELAS QUELLE DOULEUR CANTIQUE.” The edges of the paper are dogeared, tattered, and stained. The short smoking pipe has a rounded brown and ivory bowl, possibly carved from wood, and it rests upside-down on the sheet music. To our left and sitting on the brown book, a white pitcher with a tall neck and handle is painted with a landscape scene in blue on its rounded body over a flaring foot. Two more books are propped behind the brown volume so the dyed edges of the pages, one red and one green, face us. In front of those, one used and two unused matches sit on the tabletop. A white feather writing quill sits in a tapered, ivory-colored inkwell at the front right corner on a stained sage-green cloth that covers the right half of the table. Behind the inkwell and piccolo, two more books lean against a tall, silvery metal lamp, its wicks charred near the burners that extend off the reservoir. One book with a parchment-white cover has been placed upside down but the text “SHAKESPEARE” and “1605” are legible. The spine of a taller, pecan-brown book behind it reads “DANTE.” The background is mottled with shades of dark brown and terracotta red. The artist signed and dated this work with red paint in the lower left corner: “WMHARNETT 1888.”

artworks.title: La Grotte de la Loue
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles L. Lindemann
artworks.description: A pair of arched cave openings yawn in a steep, rocky cliff face that fills this horizontal painting. The cliff face is painted with dabs and textured strokes of slate gray, peachy tan, and muted blue, and some moss grows along crevices to our left. The opening to our left of center is four times the size of the smaller opening next to it. Murky green water reflects the shadowy openings and the pier-like stone between them. The water churns white over large boulders to our right, in the lower corner of the canvas. A pale-skinned man, minuscule in scale in front of the larger opening, stands barefoot with his back to us. His pants are rolled up over his knees and the long shirt sleeves up to the elbow under a vest. One hand is raised to hold a long stick. He is on what might be a pier stretching across the water. The artist signed the work with red paint in the lower left corner, “Gustave Courbet.”

artworks.title: Singerie: The Concert
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George D. Widener and Eleanor Widener Dixon
artworks.description: This is a painting of various animals dressed in human clothing and playing different musical instruments. In the center, a brown monkey in a pink tunic, ruffled collar, and plumed hat appears to be conducting, holding a rolled piece of paper in one hand and pointing at a page of sheet music with the other. The other animals include cats, dogs, goats, foxes, and sheep. Some appear to sing and hold sheet music, while others play violins, cellos, lutes, flutes, bassoons, and trumpets. Another monkey on the far left plays a piano, and a small dog in the center plays a flat, stringed instrument similar to a zither. The setting includes lush green trees, a cloudy blue sky, and architectural elements like a large gray urn and low stone walls.

artworks.title: Singerie: The Dance
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George D. Widener and Eleanor Widener Dixon
artworks.description: This is a painting of anthropomorphic monkeys engaging in activities in an outdoor space framed with columns. On the left side, a group of monkeys in colorful tunics and hats sits around a table, raising their glasses in a toast. A dog sits by their feet, and a cat looks down at them, standing on the stone wall behind the table. Closer to us, near the bottom left corner, one monkey sits by a large basket, holding a glass bottle, while another monkey holds a platter of peaches. In the center of the painting, two monkeys are dancing together. One wears a white gown with a blue corset and a white bonnet, while the other wears a yellow vest and green-blue breeches. Behind them, two monkeys sit on a barrel, one playing a horn and one playing a violin. A large colorful parrot sits on the stone wall next to them. At the bottom of the barrel, two monkeys sit close together, one in a green jacket and red trousers leaning towards one in a blue dress and white bonnet who leans away. Near the bottom right corner, one monkey in a red-and-brown tunic and a brown cap appears to vomit on the ground, while another monkey in a vest and cap stands behind them, their hands on the shoulders of the vomiting monkey. In the background, beyond the columns, we can see green trees, a winding body of water, and a blue sky with pink-and-gray clouds drifting across it.

artworks.title: Singerie: The Fishermen
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George D. Widener and Eleanor Widener Dixon
artworks.description: The image shows a riverbank with a group of monkeys fishing. The horizon line is high, showing the sky, distant hills, and a bridge. The scene has detailed brushwork depicting trees and water. The color palette is earthy with tones of brown and green, with accents of red, blue, and orange on the monkeys' clothing. In the foreground, two monkeys are in a boat with a net, while others are helping. More monkeys are shown on the right, holding poles and nets, indicating a lively scene.

artworks.title: Singerie: The Picnic
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George D. Widener and Eleanor Widener Dixon

artworks.title: Singerie: The Painter
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George D. Widener and Eleanor Widener Dixon

artworks.title: Singerie: The Sculptor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George D. Widener and Eleanor Widener Dixon
artworks.description: This is a painting of monkeys creating a sculpture. The scene shows monkeys working as sculptors. One monkey is chiseling a bust on a plinth, while others are nearby, some seeming to discuss or plan. The setting is outdoors with shrubbery, fencing, and a cloudy sky. Various tools and vessels are scattered around, creating a busy workspace. The painting captures a playful and satirical moment, featuring animals engaging in human-like activities. The style is reminiscent of the baroque period, similar to works by artist David Teniers the Younger, known for paintings of monkeys in human scenarios, also known as 'singeries.'

artworks.title: Agostino Barbarigo
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lewis Einstein
artworks.description: Shown from the thighs up, a pale-skinned man wearing armor and holding an arrow stands in front of a wine-red curtain drawn aside to show a cloud-streaked sky in this square painting. The man’s body is angled to our right, and he looks at us from the corners of his brown eyes. He has gray brows, flushed, high cheekbones, a straight nose, and his lips are closed under an ash-brown moustache over a long, gray beard. His gray hair is close cropped. His pewter-silver armor is lined and banded with gold, and decorated with lions’ heads at the shoulder we can see and across the tasset, spanning his hips. He holds the arrow in his left hand, to our right, so one end points toward his chest. The other hand rests by his side on a baton or hilt of a weapon. The curtain shows the edge of a column and stone banister, close behind the man’s far shoulder. Ivory-white clouds touched with pale pink are against a teal-blue sky in the right third of the painting.

artworks.title: Colonel Augustus James Pleasonton
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Eugene S. Pleasonton
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait painting of a man's upper body, standing with a partially turned posture to the viewer's left. His left hand is resting on a part of a cannon, while his right hand is on his hip. He has a dignified expression, strong features, cheekbones, and dark brown curly hair. The man is in a military uniform with a high collar, gold buttons, ornate shoulder epaulettes, and a red sash around his waist. The backdrop shows swirling clouds.

artworks.title: Robert Liston
artworks.creditLine: Chester Dale Collection

artworks.title: Captain Isaac Foster
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man standing in a slight profile facing the viewer's left. He has a serious expression with a clean-shaven face, strong facial features, and white hair styled to the sides. He wears a dark coat with large buttons over a white shirt featuring ruffled cuffs and a dark waistcoat underneath. His left hand rests on an ornate piece of furniture, which displays intricate carvings. The background is a plain, textured wall. The date "1755" is inscribed in the lower right corner of the painting.

artworks.title: Eleanor Wyer Foster (Mrs. Isaac Foster)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the subject from the waist up. The person is seated with both hands resting on her lap. She has a neutral expression, light skin, blue eyes, and a modest hairstyle under a sheer white bonnet. She wears a formal dress in greyish-brown color with a fitted bodice, wide sleeves with white lace cuffs, a lace neckline, and a blue ribbon tied in a bow around her neck. The subject also wears small earrings. The background is a simple gradient of muted tones.

artworks.title: Isaac Foster, Jr.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a young man with fair skin and a rounded face, wearing an 18th-century style outfit. He has light brown curly hair, a gray coat with large buttons, black collar, and white neckcloth. He stands with his right hand in his coat and his left hand slightly visible. The background is a combination of dark gray and light brown tones.

artworks.title: Dr. William Foster
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his left arm bent across his waist. He has a serious expression, distinct facial features, brown hair, and is wearing an 18th-century outfit with a brown coat, white shirt, and ruffled cuff. His right hand is tucked into his coat. The background is plain with a gradient from dark brown to lighter shades.

artworks.title: Melons and Grapes
artworks.dimensions:
overall (including painted frame): 51.5 x 60.7 cm (20 1/4 x 23 7/8 in.)
framed: 51.4 x 60.6 x 2.5 cm (20 1/4 x 23 7/8 x 1 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image features a variety of fruit, including large white melons, a sliced red watermelon, and clusters of dark and white grapes with an assortment of green leaves. The color palette includes shades of green, brown, white, pink, and black. The large white melons and the half watermelon are positioned in the foreground, while the grapes and vine leaves are in the background. The fruits and leaves are on a wooden tabletop, with the green leaves and grapes forming a backdrop.

artworks.title: Henry W. Houston
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man depicted from the waist up, holding surveying instruments in his hands. He is positioned facing slightly to the left while looking directly at the viewer. His facial features are distinct with a straight nose, thin lips, and light complexion, and his hair is short and dark, neatly combed back. He is dressed in formal attire consisting of a black suit with a white shirt and a black necktie. The man is holding a yellow ruler-like tool in one hand while the other hand holds a compass. Behind him, there is a surveyor's transit on a tripod. The background includes a tree with lush green leaves and a partially cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Aurora
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Mr. Willson
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The painting depicts a man from the thighs up, standing and facing slightly to the left with his face turned towards us. His right hand appears to be pointing downwards towards the bottom-left corner. He has a broad face with fair skin, rosy cheeks, a long nose, and small eyes. His shoulder-length brown hair has a slight wave. The man wears a long rust-colored coat with silver buttons and a white cravat, along with a white shirt and cuffs at his wrists. His left hand wears a white glove, and he is holding the other glove in that hand. He also holds a black hat under his left arm and has a sword tied to his waist. The background is dark, with a cloudy sky visible on the left and a ship sailing on dark, calm waters.

artworks.title: The Nymph of the Spring
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Clarence Y. Palitz
artworks.description: A nude woman with pale, rosy skin lies across a grassy field in front of a pool fed by water from a rocky outcropping, with a town in the distance in this horizontal painting. The woman lies back against a scarlet-red garment, presumably a dress, bunched under her shoulders, with her head to our left. Her face turns to us, but she cuts her eyes to our right, her lids nearly closed. She has a wide face, a pointed chin, and her thin, rose-pink lips are closed. Her blond hair is pulled back and gossamer fabric, nearly invisible, creates a veil reaching her arched eyebrows. She rests her head against her raised right arm, closest to the grass on which she lies, and her other arm rests along the side of her body. Her ankles are together but her knees fall slightly apart. More sheer fabric wraps across her hips. She wears a black cord tied in a bow around her neck and a longer, thick, gold chain necklace with a pendant with a ruby-red stone and pearls. On her left hand, along her body, she wears a crimson-red and gold, jeweled bracelet and three gold rings with red and blue jewels on her thumb, pointer, and pinkie fingers. The grass beneath her is painted with emerald-green plants and leaves against a dark, forest-green background. Two partridges walk in the grass, one pecking at the ground, near the lower right corner of the composition. An ash-gray tree trunk spans the height of the painting near the birds, and a bow and garnet-red, long, box-like quiver of arrows hang from a branch. Beyond the band of grass, to our left, is a pool being fed from a stream of water coming from the rocky, cave-like opening above. The pool is lined with more dark green trees and bushes. In the distance, to our right, is a town with slate-gray buildings with burgundy-red roofs. The sky above deepens from pale, sunshine yellow along the horizon to shell pink to watery blue. A rectangular plaque in the upper left corner reads, “FONTIS NYMPHA SACRI SOM NVM NE RVMP QVIESCO.” On the rock face of the cave nearby is a tiny silhouette of a serpent with folded wings holding a ring in its mouth.

artworks.title: Lady with a Fan
artworks.creditLine: Samuel H. Kress Collection
artworks.description: Shown from the knees up, a pale-skinned woman wearing a voluminous, gold-trimmed, white satin gown and a black overdress stands holding a closed fan in this vertical portrait painting. Her body and face are angled to our right, and she looks at us from the corners of her gray eyes. She has pale skin, a straight nose, thin lips, and a slight double chin. Chin-length brown waves frame her face, and the rest of her hair is pulled back. A pearl necklace lies at the base of her neck, though traces of another necklace, originally painted higher up on the neck like a choker, are visible. A lace-edged collar lies along her shoulders, and more lace lines a kerchief tucked into the low, straight neckline of her bodice. The gown’s puffy sleeves are tied around the elbows and end in wide lace-lined cuffs at the wrists. The sleeves and the front and bottom edges of the bodice are lined in glittery gold. A bejeweled gold brooch nestled in black lace is pinned to the front of her gown. A gold chain links the brooch to one side of the bodice before draping across her chest and lying over the other shoulder. A white satin ribbon is tied with a bow around her waist over the black overdress, which has subtle suggestions of a black-on-black pattern down the front. The fan is in her left hand, to our right, perhaps attached to a length of gold chain visible under her wrist. Her other hand rests in the folds of the black overdress. Some brushstrokes are visible in the woman’s clothing and in the walnut-brown background.
